text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, soft serve with extra-mega whipped 
cream and dripping with chocolate sauce~♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, that looks delicious. Maybe I'll 
get my usual soft, rich lemon with whipped 
cream, plus whatever Pandora's having.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Two of 'em?! Nice~♡ I mean, gotta pile on 
that Hachimi, right?☆

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. For some reason, I just feel 
this intense, overwhelming urge for a 
drink."

Craving that much sugar might mean fatigue 
is catching up with her. We should review 
her upcoming race schedule.
